'''Keiran Valn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who lived during the time of the Old Republic. At a banquet held by his family on his homeworld of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], Valn was murdered by a successful poisoning attempt. Even as a Jedi Knight, Valn was unable to overcome the deadly poison and he died to become one with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. The [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] was greatly troubled over the death of one of their [[Jedi Order/Legends|Order's]] members, and the preliminary investigation revealed that the poison used was a compound derived from the aquatic plant, [[green glie]], of the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].
